import unittest
from collections import OrderedDict

from solution import authorize


class AuthorizeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_all_required_scopes_are_needed(self):
        request = {'subject': 'forge', 'scopes': ['read', 'write']}
        self.assertEqual(
            authorize(request, ['read', 'write']),
            {'allowed': True, 'reason': 'ok'},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            authorize(request, ['read', 'admin']),
            {'allowed': False, 'reason': 'insufficient_scope'},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            authorize(request, ['admin']),
            {'allowed': False, 'reason': 'insufficient_scope'},
        )

    def test_empty_required_scopes_allow_authenticated_subject(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            authorize({'subject': 'user', 'scopes': []}, ()),
            {'allowed': True, 'reason': 'ok'},
        )

    def test_unauthenticated_reason_takes_precedence(self):
        self.assertEqual(
            authorize({'subject': None, 'scopes': ['read']}, []),
            {'allowed': False, 'reason': 'unauthenticated'},
        )
        self.assertEqual(
            authorize({'subject': None, 'scopes': ['read']}, ['read']),
            {'allowed': False, 'reason': 'unauthenticated'},
        )

    def test_mapping_order_irrelevant_and_result_is_new(self):
        request = OrderedDict([('scopes', ['x']), ('subject', 'u')])
        before = request['scopes'][:]
        first = authorize(request, ['x'])
        second = authorize(request, ['x'])
        self.assertEqual(first, {'allowed': True, 'reason': 'ok'})
        self.assertIsNot(first, second)
        self.assertEqual(request['scopes'], before)

    def test_invalid_request_shape_subject_and_scopes(self):
        invalid_calls = [
            lambda: authorize([], []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u'}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': [], 'extra': 1}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': '', 'scopes': []}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 4, 'scopes': []}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': 'read'}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': b'read'}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': ['read', 'read']}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': [1]}, []),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': []}, 'read'),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': []}, ['x', 'x']),
            lambda: authorize({'subject': 'u', 'scopes': []}, [1]),
        ]
        for call in invalid_calls:
            with self.subTest(call=call):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    call()


if __name__ == '__main__':
    unittest.main()
